messages:
Leila: Midday rollcall — drop 1-line updates using D/B/T (Done / Blocker / Today). I'll compile.
Matt: D: merged quantization config for p3. B: failing integration test on route-mapper (working w/ @Sanjay). T: finish canary run + monitor latency.
Sanjay: D: fixed autoscaler bug on dev cluster. B: hitting a flake in e2e token-refresh test (seen in logs). T: rerun e2e and isolate the flake.
Priya: D: completed docs draft for rollout page. B: need final copy review from @Anna. T: merge and schedule console walkthrough with PM.
Anna: D: reviewed UX flow for model pinning; left a couple inline comments. B: none. T: prep customer-facing changelog.
Kian: D: prototype batcher metrics exporter up. B: Prom labels mismatch causing missing cardinality. T: wire exporter and add tags for dev alerts.
Matt: quick check — command I use to tail batcher logs: `rlogs --since 10m --service batcher`
Matt: @DevOpsBot what's the status of the canary deploy?
DevOpsBot: Canary deployment 2023-03-01-9 pushed to region-us-west; 2/4 nodes healthy; monitoring window 10m.
Sanjay: FYI @Matt PR #842 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 — tests pass locally, flaky in CI.
Matt: will review in next 30m :thumbsup:
Leila: Quick ask — anyone blocked on infra creds for Private demos tomorrow? @Priya @Kian
Priya: creds all set for demo, no blocker.
Kian: need a read-only service account for KMS to run onprem demo, opened INF-361.
Anna: Assigned INF-361 to @Sanjay — can you take it after the e2e run?
Sanjay: Yep, will pick it up after current e2e; aim to finish triage in <2h.
Leila: FYI: All-hands tonight — bring 2 wins from the week to share. :star:
DevOpsBot: Alert: e2e-ci job 559 failed - flake in token-refresh test. Link: https://ci.redwood/559
Leila: Thanks — @Sanjay can you triage and post a short follow-up here when done?
Sanjay: Will do, posting follow-up in this thread when triage complete.
Anna: One more — tagging product: minimal changelog draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/notes/rollout-3.2 (comments welcome).
Leila: Closing for now. I'll compile the bullets and post a concise summary in #all-hands by 18:00 PT. Thanks everyone.
